entities.summary: Andre Dewayne Smith Jr. is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, earning unanimous All-American honors in 2008. He was selected by the Cincinnati Bengals in the first round of the 2009 NFL draft with the sixth overall pick. He also played for the Minnesota Vikings, Arizona Cardinals, and Baltimore Ravens.
